extracted.intended_audience: French military commanders (General Marmont) and senior staff involved in operations in Dalmatia (Napoleonic-era)
extracted.subtask_description: Operational and administrative instructions for conducting occupation, fortification, logistics, diplomacy, and troop deployments in Dalmatia and adjacent theaters (Raguse/Cattaro/Zara/Constantinople) addressed to General Marmont in 1806–1807.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concentration of mountain forces for action against Monténégrins
rubrics_metrics.description: «il réunira douze à quinze mille hommes propres à la guerre des montagnes, avec quelques pièces sur affûts de traîneaux, et écrasera les Monténégrins.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assemble 12–15,000 troops suited to mountain warfare and include artillery on sleigh-trail carriages; these forces are to be employed decisively to defeat Montenegrin opposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpretation of Raguse treaty clause
rubrics_metrics.description: «L'article du traité relatif à Raguse dit que j'en reconnais l'indépendance, mais non que je dois l'évacuer.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treaty language should be read as recognizing Raguse's independence without obliging French evacuation—use this legal interpretation to justify continued occupation/control.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior officer placement and divisional formation
rubrics_metrics.description: «Des quatre généraux de division qu'a le général Marmont, il placera Lauriston à Cattaro et Molitor à Raguse, et leur formera à chacun une belle division.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assign senior generals to specific posts (Lauriston to Cattaro, Molitor to Raguse) and form substantial divisions under each to ensure local command strength.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserve and fortification priorities around Raguse/Cattaro
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il tiendra une réserve à Stagno, fera travailler aux retranchements de la presqu'île et au fort qui doit défendre Santa-Croce, ainsi qu'à la fortification du Vieux-Raguse et à des redoutes sur les hauteurs de Raguse.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a reserve at Stagno; construct entrenchments on the peninsula, complete Fort Santa-Croce, strengthen Old-Raguse fortifications and build redoubts on surrounding heights. Request plans of ports and country to inform works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strict execution of imperial orders
rubrics_metrics.description: «Sa Majesté s'étant expliquée dans le plus grand détail, je me borne à vous recommander l'exécution de tous ses ordres, ci-dessus transcrits.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the Emperor's detailed instructions precisely; implementation fidelity is emphasized as primary duty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate civil and naval authorities for handover of Cattaro
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinate with Admiral Siniavin and the conseiller d'État Saukowsky for scheduling the remise des places et forts des bouches de Cattaro; do not set date until civil authority has replied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure civil authorities (Saukowsky) and naval commanders are consulted before fixing handover dates; allow time for Russians to embark and ships to leave the port after occupying the forts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate arrival with sufficient forces; bring supplies
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il faut, mon cher général, arriver ici tout de suite avec des forces suffisantes... Il ne faut compter trouver ici ni grains, ni boeufs, ni vin; il faut absolument tout apporter»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rapidly move adequate forces to calm local unrest and deter Russians; do not rely on local provisioning—bring all food, animals, and drink required; expect inhabitants to fear contributions but to pay when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize certain defensive positions (tactical occupation guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment that Punta d'Ostro and Scoglio need not be occupied immediately; prioritize batteries at Porto-Rose, Castelnovo and Fort Spagnola, and place gunboats under their protection with mortars to command the roadstead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not rush to occupy isolated points; prioritize works that control the anchorage and allow protective placement of gunboats; adjust plans after reconnaissance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zara as central supply and defense hub
rubrics_metrics.description: «Le centre de défense de Dalmatie est Zara, où il faut centraliser tous vos magasins de vivres, de munitions de guerre et d'habillement»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concentrate all magazines (food, munitions, clothing) at Zara to enable it to serve as a redoubt; build fieldworks and retrenchments around Zara; ensure it can be held if larger forces threaten.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid dispersion of artillery; leave minimum at coastal points
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il ne faut pas disséminer votre artillerie à Spalatro et sur les autres points; il ne faut y laisser que le strict nécessaire pour la défense de la côte.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep artillery centralized for strategic mobility and strength; only leave the minimum artillery necessary for local coastal defense to avoid weakening main positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Garrison sizing and concentration of forces
rubrics_metrics.description: «Vous ne devez laisser à Raguse qu'une garnison suffisante... Votre point d'appui doit être Zara... rapprocher la garde royale de Zara.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leave only a sufficient garrison in Raguse while concentrating main forces around Zara; consider moving elite formations (e.g., royal guard) closer to Zara as the principal stronghold.

rubrics_metrics.name: contingency dispositions if Austria or other powers act
rubrics_metrics.description: If Austria does not divide forces and does not appear before you, attack to force them to keep observation corps; if circumstances change, concentrate on Austrian frontier and possibly act offensively in Croatia; always ensure Zara is provisioned and defensible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan both defensive and offensive contingencies: prepare to hold Zara against superior forces by fortifying and establishing a retrenched camp; alternatively, exploit opportunities to force enemy dispositions if Austria does not oppose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secure communications and use of ciphers / maritime correspondence points
rubrics_metrics.description: Use ciphered correspondence when possible and rely on sea communications via Venice, Volano, Ravenne and Rimini (avoid Ancona as it may be blockaded).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement secure channels (cipher) for sensitive dispatches; prefer specific maritime relays and avoid routes likely to be interdicted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formation and levée of the Dalmatian Legion
rubrics_metrics.description: Emperor's decree for a legion dalmate to be formed to 4,000 men; current levée is insufficient (only ~37–38 men).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize recruitment and organizational measures (work with the provéditeur) to raise the Dalmatian Legion to 4,000 men to provide local troops for island and littoral service and free French troops for expeditionary duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equal Franco-Austrian coordination for Cattaro operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Convention by which an equal number of French and Austrian troops shall be provided and matériel and means equally distributed for the attack on Cattaro.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate closely with Austrian counterparts and be prepared to accept a joint scheme of execution (carried by an authorized Austrian major) with authority to receive changes from the French commander.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propaganda/deception: publicize readiness to pass the Danube
rubrics_metrics.description: «Vous devez publier que vous n'attendez que les firmans de la Porte pour passer sur le Danube»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use announcements of intended movements (awaiting firmans) as strategic signaling to intimidate or deterrent effect on enemies (e.g., Russians).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide officers and support to the Ottoman Porte
rubrics_metrics.description: Send five officers of the engineers and as many of the artillery to Constantinople; send staff officers to pachas of Bosnie and Bucharest; provide counsel and supplies (munitions, cartouches, poudre, canons) as requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commit engineering and artillery expertise to assist Ottoman defensive works (Dardanelles, Constantinople, Bosphorus, Smyrna, Salonique); advise local authorities and help supply material needs when possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit forward detachments beyond frontier
rubrics_metrics.description: «Bien entendu que les détachements français ne s'éloigneraient jamais à plus de deux lieues au delà des frontières.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not advance French detachments more than two leagues beyond the frontier—avoid deep forward dispersion without orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond to Ottoman requests for specific personnel (500 cannoneers / 600-man corps)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests from the Grand Seigneur/Divan for 500 canoniers; Imperial order to send a corps of ~600 men (artillerymen, sappers, ouvriers) with officers of artillery and engineers to Constantinople.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize assembling and dispatching required corps quickly; use troops from Raguse or Dalmatie as appropriate to meet Ottoman urgencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed composition and provisioning of the 600-man corps
rubrics_metrics.description: Composition: four companies (artillery) completed to 120 men each (total ~440), two companies of sappers (~170), ~50 ouvriers; about a dozen artillery and engineer officers; equip well, provide three months' pay, three pairs of shoes per man, valuable tools for ouvriers, useful books for officers of engineers and artillery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When forming the corps, choose strong, fit men; complete company strengths from available infantry; select good artificiers among solder-workers; ensure thorough equipment (fusils, solid clothing), tools not readily available in Constantinople, and provisioning for at least three months of service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to send larger forces contingent on formal Ottoman requisition
rubrics_metrics.description: Imperial authorization to send up to 4–5,000 men to the Porte if properly requisitioned with written request from General Sébastiani and a firman from the pacha through whose territory troops would pass.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not exceed sending large forces without strict formal requisition documents (réquisition and firman). Legal/ceremonial paperwork is required for larger commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide financial support when possible
rubrics_metrics.description: «L'intention de l'Empereur est que... vous fassiez passer... deux cent mille francs en or au général Sébastiani»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If funds are available, dispatch 200,000 gold francs with the troop detachment to support needs of Turkish defense; if funds are not available, report lack so alternative measures can be taken.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize sending engineers and artillery officers; do not hoard
rubrics_metrics.description: «Ainsi n'épargnez pas les officiers du génie et d'artillerie pour les envoyer à Constantinople... Vous pouvez donc envoyer, si vous le jugez convenable, tout ce qui n'est point strictement nécessaire.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give precedence to sending engineering and artillery experts to theatres that most need them; free up officers not strictly necessary for local garrisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit high-ranking staff presence locally
rubrics_metrics.description: «À quoi vous servent cinq colonels ou chefs de bataillon? Un à Raguse et un en Dalmatie vous suffisent.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid excessive concentration of senior officers locally; maintain only the necessary number of colonels or battalion commanders in each key place to prevent inefficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disciplinary measures for failures (example of Curzola)
rubrics_metrics.description: Order to demand the commander of Curzola and make an example of him if guilty for the loss of the island — «Faites redemander le commandant de Curzola et faites-en un bon exemple, s'il est coupable.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply exemplary discipline for dereliction or culpability in command; investigate and, if culpable, punish to deter similar failures elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of French officers as political-military agents to Ottoman provinces
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendation that French officers visit provinces of the Porte to show imperial goodwill and to obtain useful intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dispatch French officers on missions of liaison and influence among Ottoman pachas to both strengthen ties and collect local information beneficial to French operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imperial recognition of Zara as only fortress in Dalmatia
rubrics_metrics.description: «Sa Majesté ne veut et ne connaît en Dalmatie d'autre place forte que Zara.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus fortification resources and strategic priority on Zara as the single, recognized stronghold in Dalmatia; deprioritize other local fortification projects in favor of Zara.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing and rapid execution of troop dispatches
rubrics_metrics.description: «L'intention de l'Empereur est, général, que tout ce que je viens de vous ordonner parte vingt-quatre heures après la réception des ordres.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Execute dispatch and mobilization orders with urgency; in certain cases the Emperor expects departures within 24 hours of receipt of the order.
